Q: Is it possible to edit/change a resource file within a Jar in Java? A:

Just a heads up, the readSettings() function should probbably start with

Path p = Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"),"your-app-settings.properties");

or otherwise do something with p before it invokes Files.newBufferedReader(p). Trying to open the path returned by the user.home System property wkith a BufferedReader is unlikely to yield anything usefull.
